segments.normalizedSource: ```swift @AppStorage("sidebarCustomizations") var tabViewCustomization: TabViewCustomization @State private var selectedTab: Tabs = .watchNow var body: some View { TabView(selection: $selectedTab) { Tab("Watch Now", systemImage: "play", value: .watchNow) { WatchNowView() } .customizationID(Tabs.watchNow.customizationID) // More tabs... } .tabViewCustomization($tabViewCustomization) } ```
